caption:
That minus sign out front is lying.

−x(x − 2)²(3 − x) has leading term +x⁴, so both ends rise. The (3 − x) hides a second negative.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Negative out front, but the graph rises on both ends. Here's why.
